lessons.c:
Assign with :=. Arithmetic uses + - * /. Comparison uses = <> < > <= >=. Logic uses AND, OR, NOT and XOR.

Multiplication happens before addition, and parentheses make your intent clear.

lessons.c: CASE chooses code by the value of an integer or enumeration. Each branch lists a value, and ELSE catches anything unmatched. It is ideal for state machines.
lessons.x: A machine has states: 0 idle, 1 running, 2 fault.
lessons.ex: Add a state 3 for maintenance mode.
q: ELSE inside CASE is the default.

lessons.c:
FOR repeats a known number of times using a counter. WHILE repeats as long as a condition is TRUE.

The whole loop runs inside one scan, so keep loops short. An endless loop freezes the PLC cycle.
lessons.x: Add up ten sensor readings stored in an array.
lessons.ex: Write a FOR loop that adds the numbers 1 to 5.
q: WHILE checks the condition each pass.
An endless loop in a PLC:
The whole loop executes in one pass.
